definition.name: SWAP_operator
definition.definition: The SWAP operator on C^d tensor C^d acts by SWAP(|a> tensor |b>) = |b> tensor |a>. In the computational basis, SWAP = sum_{i,j} |i><j| tensor |j><i|. It is both unitary and Hermitian (SWAP^2 = I). For density matrices, tr(SWAP (rho tensor sigma)) = tr(rho sigma). The permutation operator P(pi) on (C^d)^{tensor n} permutes tensor factors: P(pi)|v_1> tensor ... tensor |v_n> = |v_{pi^{-1}(1)}> tensor ... tensor |v_{pi^{-1}(n)}>.
